# mURL

> A free browser extension that drops you into a live, anonymous chat for
> whatever website you are currently on. Everyone using mURL on the same site
> shares one real-time room. No account, no email, one click. Powered by mosADD.

## What it is
- A consumer browser extension (Chrome first). Open it on any website and you join
  that site's room (e.g. nike.com -> #nike.com). All sub-pages of a site collapse
  into one shared room.
- Anonymous: a random nickname per install, no sign-up, no email, no fingerprint.
- Free for everyone. Website owners may optionally claim, brand, or disable the
  room on a domain they verify (DNS) — the only paid, opt-in part.

## Audience
- Anyone, any age 16+, who wants to talk to other people on the site they're on:
  shoppers, readers of an article, people on a service/institution site.

## Key pages
- / : landing — how it works, use cases, live trending rooms, FAQ
- /privacy : privacy policy
- /abuse : report abuse / DMCA, and how owners disable a room
- /<domain> : deep-link landing for a specific room, e.g. /nike.com

## Relationship to mosADD
mURL is made by mosADD (mosadd.dev / mosadd.com) and runs on the same real-time
backbone as the mosADD comms toolkit. Independent of the websites it appears on.
